integrity: Two independent exact enumerators were executed against all stated finite candidate sets; code included and free of external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive theorem only for AG(2,q), q in {2,3,4,5}. No claim for larger or non-Desarguesian affine planes; historical priority cannot be absolutely excluded.
title: A nonmonotone four-order contagion sequence and the exact optimal-seed census of the affine plane of order five
